Sample.title: Interior of Apollo Mission Simulator crew station
Sample.description: Interior view of the Apollo Mission Simulator (AMS) crew station located in bldg 5. The AMS is a primary training system which will prepare Apollo astronauts for flights. The AMS stands nearly 30 feet high and weighs approximately 40 tons. The simulator is designed to familiarize Apollo crews with equipment, crew tasks, mission procedures, and emergency flight situations.
